written.headline: NVIDIA expands physical and agentic AI services to cities worldwide
written.summary: NVIDIA and partners are deploying physical AI, agentic AI and digital twins in cities across Europe, Asia and the United States, using shared computing infrastructure to let local governments run AI locally. Projects include resident‑service bots in Madrid, vision agents in Poland and traffic‑management agents in Malaysia that aim to support over 17,000 cameras by 2027.

written.headline: India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026
written.summary: OpenAI says India now has the highest weekly active user count for ChatGPT worldwide, with the local user base having doubled since January 2026. The company is expanding local computing capacity, Indian-language features and Android‑first products, and plans UPI‑related announcements.
